title: MetaboCast: predicting spatial metabolite maps from spatial transcriptomics with per-ion reliability
description: MetaboCast learns from paired mass-spectrometry imaging and spatial transcriptomics to predict metabolite ion maps for transcriptome-only sections. Every predicted ion carries an empirical uncertainty width, its accuracy within sections and on unseen sections, a reliability tier that separates the two, and putative exact-mass candidates. The release contains the Python package, the R/Seurat interface, a model trained on seven paired DESI-MSI/Visium tumour sections, the exported SMA spot-to-pixel pairing, and the scripts and result files behind every figure and table of the accompanying manuscript.
